messages:
Ravi: Heads-up 1: NimbusLabs reserved-cap bring-up Wednesday 08:00 UTC. Contract renewal flagged if first-week SLA misses >3. Quota target 150k tokens/min, peak 225k. Need eng + SRE + CS on war room.

Marta: Acknowledged. I'll prepare autoscale policy: metric=token_rate_per_node, target_util=0.7, min=2, max=12, scale_window=90s. Will also add hysteresis to avoid cascade.

Evan: Proposed latency SLOs: p50 < 130ms, p95 < 480ms. Canary 8% to quantized variant (nimbus-q6). If memory pressure then fallback to hosted with token-level attribution.

Sergio: Nimbus will warm prefixes at 07:20 UTC and rotate keys at 07:40. They asked for a 20-min handoff and a short KMS smoke check (Azure Key Vault).

Ravi: Runbook sketch:
- 06:30 infra smoke
- 07:00 node priming and taint checks
- 07:20 client warmup start
- 07:40 KMS validation + handshake
- 08:00 ramp: 5% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% (20m steps)
- 09:10 drain-one-node chaos test
- 09:30 90m soak at target
Load snippet (k6):
```js
export default function() { http.post(__ENV.TGT + '/v1/chat', JSON.stringify({msgs:['hi'],max_tokens:48})); }
```
Ramp VUs: 25 -> 250 -> 700 over 60m.

Marta: Alerts I'll add: queue_len > 350 (2m), avg_token_latency > 1.1s (3m), replica_mem_high. On alert: route 25% to hosted fallback and notify #customer-alerts with "nimbus-fallback" tag.

BringupBot: Reminder: "NimbusLabs reserved pool bring-up" scheduled for 2024-07-10T08:00:00Z 1 runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbus-bringup.

Evan: Also capturing renewal risk: if SLA breach occurs we must run immediate root-cause and offer 2-week credit + engineered warmup assistance. Capture post-run feedback and top-3 perf blockers.

Sergio: I'll confirm Azure KMS permissions now and DM Nimbus for their top endpoints. Also will ask them to pin session prefixes to improve cache hits.

Ravi: Action items: @Marta = push autoscale + alerts + routing; @Evan = prepare canary and cache priming scripts; @Sergio = KMS check and customer invite. War room link posted 30m before. :rocket:

Marta: Running a dry-run in staging tonight, will post metrics (p50/p95, queue, mem) by EOD.

Ravi: Good. Let's minimize risk and capture feedback for renewal packet. See you on the war room.
